resources.string: Create a local backup of your characters, variables, rolls, level rules, settings and roll history. Nothing is uploaded by Dice Thrower.
Save a versioned JSON backup using Android’s document picker. You choose where the file is stored.
Choose a Dice Thrower backup. The file is validated before any local data is replaced.
This validated backup contains %1$d characters and %2$d rolls. Restoring it will replace the current local data and settings.
Character images are embedded in backup v2 and verified during restore, so they remain portable across devices. Legacy v1 URI references are still supported when accessible.
